Messages.Author: dancin...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
The other night, we're playing V:tES, and my predator taps his
Metro Underground at the end of his turn to untap one of my
prey's vampires. My first instinct is to say he can't do that, but
we didn't have any rulings on us save the Jyhad and Sabbat
booklet, so we thought "What the hell".

Now, I just looked up the rulings, clarifications, errata, and rules
pages, and nowhere do I find that you can't use Metro to untap
another Methuselah's vampire, even though I'm pretty sure you
can't. Where can I find the ruling, if there is one, that clears this
up?

dancingmummy

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.
